about: Paging scenarios: steps on the table and the page requests each causes, in order. See README.md for the steps and the events.

controls.name: cancel a stale read to restart it
drop a short last page that grows

steps.why: Only the visible page starts while it isn't loaded.
Resting: prefetch 2 each side (none above page 0).
Rows 1000..1028 span pages 0-1; moving down, prefetch is 4 ahead (2-5); 3 reads in flight at most.
Pages 4 and 5 are still in flight, and every wanted page is loaded or loading.
Rows 3000..3028 are page 2: wanted 2, then 3,1,4,0,5,6; 4 and 5 are in flight, so one more read.
249 ms since the last move: still leaning ahead.
Rested 250 ms: prefetch evens out to 2 each side (0-4), so 5 and 6 are cancelled.
The cancelled reads answer and free their places; nothing more is wanted.
floor(0.9 x rows) is row 1410770, on page 1377. Pages 1 and 2 are stale and cancelled, but they hold their places until they answer: one place left, for the visible page.
A place is free, but no prefetch starts while the visible page loads.
Visible page in: prefetch, 2 places (page 2 still draining). Moving down: 1378, 1376, 1379, 1375, 1380, 1381.
Rested: 1375-1379 wanted, and every read in flight is among them.
A drag loads nothing until the pointer rests 80 ms. Top = 0.25 x (rows - viewport_rows).
Moved again: the 80 ms start over.
Rested 80 ms at rows 783747..783776 (page 765): only the visible page, which isn't loaded.
Page 765 isn't cancelled yet: nothing is decided until the pointer rests or lets go.
Letting go loads at once: page 1148; 765 is stale.
Still leaning ahead (the last move was under 250 ms ago).
Rested: 1146-1150 wanted, all loaded; loaded pages are never cancelled.
A press on the track jumps the thumb there and starts a drag.
The release comes before the 80 ms: it loads at once.
The last page, 1530, is short: rows 1566720..1567523.
Nothing below the last page; 2 behind.
Rows 1566495..1566523 are page 1529. Moving up: 4 ahead above (1528-1525), 2 behind below (1530).
Rested: 2 each side, 1527-1530.
A failed visible page shows its error and doesn't hold prefetch back.
A failure isn't retried while it stays in view.
Scrolled away: the failure is forgotten.
Back: the failed page is read again.
16 MiB pages: four fit in 64 MiB.
Each page past the budget evicts the least recently used page that isn't wanted; wanted pages stay, over budget or not.
Pages 0-2 were evicted.
Page 1 (rows 1024..1500, short) is the only one past page 0.
The end: rows 1472.5..1500, page 1, loaded.
Page 1 no longer holds every row it covers: forgotten, and read anew (the visible page has nothing to show).
Grown again during its read: that read is cancelled (it holds its place until it answers), and the page read anew.
Page 1 was short (1024..1700): forgotten again, though it's whole now.
2048 rows were whole pages: nothing forgotten. The new page 2 is prefetch below the view.
The top moves up to the new end (rows 1172.5..1200, page 1). Page 1 was short: forgotten, with or without live, and read anew.
A loaded visible page is read again; its old rows draw until the read lands.
One read per page in flight: the read out isn't cancelled for being stale.
Invalidated during its read: read once more after it lands, however many times it changed.

scenarios.name: a page changes during its first read

steps.why: Its first read is out: not cancelled.
Stale when it lands: drawn, and read again before prefetch, which it doesn't hold back.

scenarios.name: a page changes during a drag

steps.why: Top = 0.0005 x (rows - viewport_rows): rows 783..811, still page 0.
The pointer hasn't rested: the re-read waits with every other load.
Rested 80 ms: the visible page's re-read, then prefetch leaning down (1-4; 1 and 2 are loaded).
Rested, so it would load now, but page 0's read is out.
Rows 0..2100 are pages 0-2.
Re-reads hold at most max_in_flight - 1 places: page 2 waits.
Rows 3072..5172 are pages 3-5; wanted 3,4,5,6,2,7,1,8,9. Page 0's re-read isn't wanted: cancelled, and its stale page dropped. Page 5 has nothing to show: it starts at once.
Once page 5 is in, prefetch, with stale page 2's re-read in wanted's order.
The old rows stay drawn, not an error; not read again until its rows change again.
Pages 0-2 stay cached, unwanted.
Pages 0-2 aren't wanted: dropped, not read again.
Dropped, so page 0 has nothing to show: no prefetch until it lands (a stale page kept would have let 1 and 2 start).

scenarios.name: a re-read lands during a drag

steps.why: Rows 783747..783776, page 765: nothing loads until the pointer rests.
A read landing mid-drag starts nothing either: the drag's pages wait for its settle.

scenarios.name: a grown last page is kept

steps.why: Kept, stale: rows 1024..1500 draw as read, 1500..1600 as placeholders, and the page is read again.
Grown during its re-read: not cancelled.
Read once more after it lands, however many times it grew.
Page 1 (1024..1800) grew to whole: read again. Its new rows are visible page 1's, so no prefetch until they land, as when a visible page is missing.
Page 1 holds every row now: the new page 2 is prefetch below it.

scenarios.name: a last page grows during its first read

steps.why: Page 1's first read, as prefetch.
Its first read is out: not cancelled.
It lands holding rows 1024..1500, stale: read again for 1500..1600.
Shrinking forgets the short last page, as without live: its re-read is cancelled, and the page read anew at the new end.
